name: ehos-dev
description: Skills shared by eh-os, ehos-tools and eh-os-contract: how a changelog line is written and a component released (eh-os D-91), how a planned piece of work is run through a GitHub issue, how a change is reviewed before its pull request, how its description is written and it is opened, from the template every EHOS repository and application shares, how a decision record is written in eh-os and ehos-tools, how eh-os's architecture is kept current with a change, how Elixir and its tests are written in the three, and how any text a person reads about EHOS is written, in the docs and the console: the sentence rules of ASD-STE100 and the words of the glossary of the component that owns each word; and how a diagram in that documentation is drawn and generated with ehos_diagrams (eh-os D-107).
